translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Wer ma ji wero kadhi e hekalu.

content.text: Parie Daudi, yaye Jehova Nyasaye,
parie Daudi gi chandruok duto moseneno.
Ne okwongʼore kane osingore ne Jehova Nyasaye,
kendo ne okwongʼore ne Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo kama:
“Ok anadonji e oda,
kata dhi e kitandana,
Ok anayie nindo tera,
kata ayula wangʼ lo wengena,
kapok aloso ne Jehova Nyasaye kare,
kapok ayudo ne Nyasaye Maratego mar Jakobo kar dak.”
Ne wawinjo wachno Efratha,
ee, ne wayude e puothe mag Jaar:
“Wadhiuru kare modakie;
wadhiuru mondo walame e nyim kom duongʼne, ka wawacho niya,
‘Aa malo, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, aa malo ibi kari mar yweyo,
in kaachiel gi Sandug Muma ma en kido mar tekoni.
Mad jodolo magi rwakre gi tim makare,
kendo mad jogi maler wer gi mor.’ ”
Nikech Daudi jatichni,
kik idagi ngʼati miseyiero.
Jehova Nyasaye nokwongʼore kendo osingore ne Daudi,
kendo ne en kwongʼruok ma ok enoloki ngangʼ;
nokwongʼorene niya,
“Abiro keto achiel kuom kothi e lochni,
ka yawuoti orito singruokna
kod chike ma apuonjogi,
eka yawuotgi nobedi,
e lochni nyaka chiengʼ kendo nyaka chiengʼ.”
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye oseyiero Sayun,
osehere kaka kar dakne, osewacho ni,
Ma e kar yweyona mochwere manyaka chiengʼ,
kae ema abiro betie kom lochna, nimar asehere,
abiro gwedhe gi gik moko mogundho,
kendo joge modhier abiro romo gi chiemo.
Abiro rwako jodolo mage gi warruok
kendo jomaler modak e iye biro siko ka wero wende mor.
“Ka eni ema abiro miyo tung moro donge ne Daudi
kendo abiro chungo taya ne ngʼata mowir.
Abiro bako wasike gi wichkuot,
to en osimbo manie wiye biro medo rieny.”
